:::{#exm-ldpc-rate}
#### The rate of the length-6 code

<!-- no-figure: the example is two computed numbers -->

For the $(2, 3)$-regular code of @exm-ldpc-code,
@thm-ldpc-rate gives a rate of at least $1 - 2 / 3$.
The code has 8 codewords, so its rate is $\log_2(8) / 6$.

```{r}
#| label: ldpc-rate
1 - 2 / 3
log2(8) / 6
```

The rate is $1/2$, which is larger than $1/3$.
The four rows of $H$ add to zero modulo 2, because every column has two ones,
so $H$ has rank 3, not 4.

:::
